description:
Pearse Lodge B&B presents a rare opportunity to acquire a distinguished family-owned and operated guesthouse with a successful operational history dating back to 1994. This distinguished property boasts 10 bedrooms, functioning as a fully operational business with a dedicated and loyal customer base, including numerous repeat guests annually. Meticulously maintained and continually upgraded by the family owners, the property has seen several extensions and enhancements, including the installation of solar water heating systems and electricity panels, reflecting a commitment to sustainability and modern efficiency. The accommodation is precisely designed, with a clear delineation between private family living quarters and guest facilities. The owners’ accommodation features a well-appointed kitchen and breakfast area, a spacious living room with a feature stone fireplace and stove, utility facilities, a family bathroom, and three bedrooms, including a shower room. The guest accommodation comprises seven bedrooms, each with en-suite facilities, four on the ground floor and three on the first floor, offering guests privacy and comfort throughout their stay. The property’s communal areas include an inviting dining room, a reading and sitting room, and a sunlit garden room overlooking the gardens, creating an attractive and homely atmosphere. Externally, the property benefits from ample off-street parking, a dedicated storage compound, a separate bike shed, and independent gated rear access. The grounds are enclosed by a traditional stone boundary wall and feature beautifully maintained gardens, enhancing both privacy and aesthetic appeal. This outstanding property is situated within walking distance of Sligo Town Centre, Markievicz Park, local transport links, including bus and rail stations, as well as a variety of shops, restaurants, primary & secondary schools. Pearse Lodge offers exceptional versatility, as it can serve as a family home or be adapted for other residential care needs, providing flexibility to suit a range of future plans. This turnkey operation boasts an outstanding reputation, strong repeat business, and a genuine warm and welcoming setting. For further information or to arrange a viewing, please contact Oates Breheny Group at 071-9140404.
